edict_42_lexicon.warning_toast: ⚠️ HARMONY VIOLATION DETECTED: Your MirrorNet packet has been logged by the Office of the High Inquisitor.

coded_slang_dictionary.forbidden_concept: The Sovereign of Ash / Dark Lord
coded_slang_dictionary.coded_phrase_th: พายุเถ้าถ่านทางเหนือ / แนวปะทะอากาศหนาว
coded_slang_dictionary.usage_context: Disguising dark war troop movements as meteorological and astronomy weather reports.

coded_slang_dictionary.coded_phrase_th: คุณป้าชุดชาคาโมมายล์
coded_slang_dictionary.usage_context: Mocking Vespera's sickly sweet demeanor and obsession with herbal tea while issuing brutal detentions.

coded_slang_dictionary.coded_phrase_th: ชมรมถักผ้าพันคอกันหนาว
coded_slang_dictionary.usage_context: 'Knitting purl stitches' = practicing shield charms; 'dropped a stitch' = spell backfired.

coded_slang_dictionary.forbidden_concept: Sneaking out post-curfew / Secret romantic rendezvous
coded_slang_dictionary.coded_phrase_th: ไปเช็กความชื้นเห็ดเรืองแสง
coded_slang_dictionary.usage_context: Double entendre used both for late-night romantic dates and passing contraband intelligence.

coded_slang_dictionary.coded_phrase_th: นกกะรางปากเงิน
coded_slang_dictionary.usage_context: Refers to Julian Thorne and aristocratic informants trading screenshots for Ministry favor.

coded_slang_dictionary.forbidden_concept: Smuggling persecuted Mundane-born students to safety
coded_slang_dictionary.coded_phrase_th: ทัศนศึกษาเก็บตัวอย่างรากไม้
coded_slang_dictionary.usage_context: Coordinates midnight evacuations through the subterranean tunnel behind Greenhouse 3.

coded_slang_dictionary.forbidden_concept: Forced initiation into the Ash Sovereign's inner circle
coded_slang_dictionary.coded_phrase_th: กลับไปลองชุดพิธีการของตระกูล
coded_slang_dictionary.usage_context: Cassian's coded distress signal when his father summons him home to take the dark oath.

arcane_gift_catalog.item_name_th: เยลลี่เปลี่ยนสีผมตามอารมณ์
arcane_gift_catalog.mechanic_effect: Temporarily dyes the recipient's hair tips based on hidden emotion (Peach-Pink = Flustered, Crimson = Jealous, Indigo = Melancholy).

arcane_gift_catalog.item_name_th: ช็อกโกแลตทรัฟเฟิลผงง่วงนอน
arcane_gift_catalog.mechanic_effect: Lulls Caretaker Argos's gargoyle sentries to sleep for 15 minutes, bypassing post-curfew penalty during Night Phase.

arcane_gift_catalog.item_name_th: ปากกาขนนกสารภาพในใจ
arcane_gift_catalog.mechanic_effect: Enchanted quill that writes smooth, lyrical prose with enchanting elegance.

arcane_gift_catalog.item_name_th: นกกระดาษกระซิบเสียง
arcane_gift_catalog.mechanic_effect: Delivers a self-immolating voice whisper through air vents. Completely immune to Edict 42 censorship scanning for 1 conversation turn.

arcane_gift_catalog.item_name_th: หูฟังคู่ลงอาคมกันคลื่นรบกวน
arcane_gift_catalog.mechanic_effect: Rune-shielded 90s Mundane earphones that resist castle mana interference. Unlocks Rowan's Greenhouse 3 Indie Rock date.

arcane_gift_catalog.item_name_th: ขวดแก้วเก็บแสงเหนือ
arcane_gift_catalog.mechanic_effect: Projects shimmering emerald sky-lights onto dark dorm ceilings. Essential comfort item for Faye during Year 4 grief.

academy_curriculum.course_name_th: ศาสตร์หม้อหลอมและการสกัดสารระเหย
academy_curriculum.quirk: Speaks in an eerie whisper audible across the dungeon; deducts House Points in decimals (e.g., -3.5 points).

academy_curriculum.course_name_th: การแปลงรูปวัตถุไร้ชีวิต
academy_curriculum.quirk: Razor-sharp hawk gaze; texting on a Mirror-Slate mid-lecture risks temporary device confiscation.

academy_curriculum.course_name_th: พฤกษศาสตร์กินเนื้อและเห็ดมนตรา
academy_curriculum.quirk: Keeps a family of sugar-gliders in his beard; casually forgets which greenhouse vines bite fingers.

academy_curriculum.course_name_th: ตรรกศาสตร์อักษรรูนและการเข้ารหัส
academy_curriculum.quirk: Assigns brutal 5-scroll translation essays weekly; inadvertently teaches students how to bypass Ministry filters.

academy_curriculum.course_name_th: คาถาต่อต้านคำสาป (ปี 5 เปลี่ยนเป็น วิชาความมั่นคงพลเมือง)
academy_curriculum.quirk: Exciting dueling drills in Years 1-4; replaced by silent Ministry decree copying under Vespera in Year 5.

critical_scenario_seeds.title: Trapped in the Herbology Closet
critical_scenario_seeds.summary: Hiding inches apart in a pitch-black cedar closet while Caretaker Argos's lantern swings past the keyhole; communicating strictly via minimum-brightness Mirror-Slate texts.

critical_scenario_seeds.title: Solstice First Kiss & Summer Grief
critical_scenario_seeds.summary: Contrast between romantic Winter Gala euphoria and the devastating summer tournament death; player must comfort them through unspoken grief instead of believing stoic surface replies.

critical_scenario_seeds.title: Snowfall Ultimatum at the Iron Gates
critical_scenario_seeds.summary: A black family carriage waits in the snow or inquisitors approach the dorm; decisive moral crossroads locking Golden vs Tragic Endgame path.

critical_scenario_seeds.title: Final Siege SOS (Mana 8%)
critical_scenario_seeds.summary: Perimeter wards collapsing over Loch Aethel; unfiltered final confessions transmitted as MirrorNet signal flickers out.
